en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cobblestone street lined with old gabled townhouses. Dominating the scene is a long two‑storey inn with dormer windows and signs in German Fraktur script reading "Hôtel zum Sächsischen Hof" and advertising a garden restaurant and concert hall. A man stands at the entrance beneath an ornate wrought‑iron canopy, while a horse‑drawn carriage with two horses and two people is stopped in front of the building. Another small street sign is visible on the corner of the hotel façade.
